films.description: 2026年11月14日录制：code78 真机官网下载与打开安装包，安装入口另用明确标注的真机截图。手机设置、八位邀请和六位核码是步骤说明；末段为 code77 已接入手机的真实 Muse 任务回执补录。示例手机原本已安装并连接，没有重演首装、授予权限或重新配对。下载部分由维护端独立 Airtap 连接操作；Muse 片段由 Muse 原连接录制。本轮素材不使用 USB，原速剪辑、省略等待、无音轨。不是独立新用户验收。

code77 / Android 15 真实手机录屏：Gmail 中的3份申请草稿与1份图文稿、实际打开内容草稿核对，以及任务后补录的 Muse 回执。业务由 Muse 原连接完成，录制与取回由维护端受委托协调；未用 USB。视频回看保存结果，不是研究、写作和发送的完整连续记录；任务示例卡不是实际发送画面。4个岗位页面经手机核对，另1个遇到验证后停止；资格与报酬未知项仍保留。自有测试图片用于附件核验，没有发送、投递或发布。原速节选、无音轨，片长不等于任务耗时。

verification.privacy_review: Public website, owner-approved task drafts without recipients or personal resume, relevant Muse receipt; no credentials, invitation or verification codes, notifications, phone numbers or unrelated conversations in selected frames. Original recordings and receipts remain private.
verification.grok_review: Real Grok via llm-cli reviewed only the sanitized shot text, not the videos. Applied clear separation of instructional cards, already-paired examples and later-recorded receipts; no review claims about video pixels.

browser.local: Actual click-play, seek and pause for both videos; usage Space key paused the player. 390px and320px views had no horizontal overflow; temporary viewport override reset.
browser.public: Both current public video URLs actually played, reported readyState4 and40/57-second durations; seek and pause worked.

limits: Installation is a guide, not a first-user installation or pairing acceptance.
Usage video shows real saved results and reopening, not continuous original research or writing.
File transfer required bounded retries/resume; successful hashes do not establish fast bulk-media transport.

publication.first_failure: Initial check rejected the longer robots.txt response. Full public text was read: reviewed Cloudflare Managed prefix plus the exact frozen robots.txt. The second104-check run passed with that exact prefix; shared Cloudflare settings were not changed.
publication.media_checks: Both films matched complete public bytes and SHA256; HEAD lengths and206 byte ranges passed. Recommended APK and retired-download responses also passed.
